title: Conduct Guard Rule Schema v1
description: Machine-readable schema for a single Guard rule and a Guard pack (a bundle of rules). Guard rules are enforced across four surfaces: Guard proxy (LLM egress), pre-tool hooks (Claude Code / Cursor / Codex), MCP guard_check, and the workflow runtime. Rules are portable — the same rule renders to Cedar for AWS Verified Permissions ecosystems.

action.description: What Guard does when the rule matches. `block` refuses the tool call; `warn` surfaces a warning but proceeds; `allow` is an explicit permit; `audit` records without decision; `inject` prepends context to the prompt; `approval` pauses the run until a human approves.

severity.description: Severity tag used by dashboards + audit filters. No enforcement effect.

persona.description: Which persona the rule applies to. `agent` = local coding agent (Claude Code, Cursor). `proxy` = server-side LLM egress via Guard proxy.

enforcement.description: Surface-by-surface enforcement capability for this rule. Runtime uses this to decide which surfaces can actually block vs advise.

rule.description: One Guard rule. Evaluated at every tool call the rule's match_tool covers.

id.description: Stable identifier. Unique within the pack. Referenced by GuardRuleOverride to disable or amend.

description.description: Human-readable summary — shown in dashboards + Cedar `@description` annotation.

match_tool.description: Comma-separated tool names the rule applies to (e.g. `edit,write,bash`). Empty or `*` means all tools.

match_pattern.description: Regex matched against the tool_input.prompt / body. Case-sensitive; anchors optional.

match_path_pattern.description: Regex matched against the tool_input.path (file operations). Independent from `match_pattern`.

message.description: Shown to the user when the rule fires. Appears in Cedar `@message` annotation.

recommendation.description: Remediation guidance. Appears in Cedar `@recommendation` annotation.

persona_affinity.description: Personas this rule applies to. Defaults to all if omitted.

frameworks.description: Compliance tags (e.g. `PCI_DSS:3.4`, `SOC2:CC6.1`, `ISO_42001:8.24`, `MITRE_ATLAS:AML.T0051`, `OWASP_AGENTIC:A01`). Appears in Cedar `@compliance` annotation.

iso_control.description: ISO 27001 / ISO 42001 control ID (e.g. `A.8.11`). Appears in Cedar `@iso_control` annotation.

ui.description: Optional presentation hints for the pack tile on /packs.

pack.description: A Guard pack — a bundle of rules. Distributed as a JSON file under `apps/api/app/modules/guard/skill_packs/{slug}.json` or imported via the Cedar interchange endpoint.
